rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (frozen page text layer) names the item. Booleans take xbox_joins (box immediately left of the printed option; _1/_2/_3 follow printed order). Schedule 1 rows map by the block letter, the printed effective-year caption and the Export/Taxable/Due column headers. Part III and Part IV amounts pair the 11-slot peso comb with the 2-slot centavo comb directly right (money_joins). Part III and Part IV date combs stay blank. Rows printed for 2024 onwards, vapor item 6 and item 7 (7A/7B) stay blank. Keys with no printed cell (1A/1B/1C/2/3A/3B/4A/4B/5 for 2020-2021, 7B) stay blank.
